Specification: This specification models a small state machine intended to expose or test an initialization-state related bug. It defines recursive operators for enumerating all subsets of a set and summing the elements of a set, then uses a choice operator to select a subset whose sum is greater than 4. The system has three state variables and transitions in two steps from an initial state, first assigning a large powerset-based value and then assigning the set of all subsets of 1..8; the comments note that one range was increased from 1..8 to 1..20 to test performance.
IfThenElse: IF S = {} THEN {{}} ELSE LET c == CHOOSE c \in S : TRUE; T == S \ {c}; TT == AllSubs(T) IN TT \cup { t \cup {c} : t \in TT }
IF S = {} THEN 0 ELSE LET c == CHOOSE c \in S : TRUE IN c + Sum(S \ {c})
CaseExpr: CASE pc = 0 -> pc' = 1 /\ set' = S1 /\ fun' = Ch(set') [] pc = 1 -> pc' = 2 /\ set' = S2 /\ fun' = Ch(set') [] OTHER -> FALSE
